prs.tagLine: Life with you at the centre

description:
Ideally located in Dublin's Central Business District, The Residence Coopers Cross is a stunning development of brand-new apartments available to rent. The Residence Coopers Cross boasts an exceptional collection of Studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom homes in Dublin's newest urban quarter. 

The apartments are spacious and beautifully designed, focusing on the important elements of apartment living. The clean and simple design of these generously proportioned apartments gives a light and airy feel to every home. The apartments are finished to an extremely high specification and some of these features include: 

-	Floor to ceiling windows
-	Large balconies 
-	Designer fit out 
-	Luxury bathrooms and en-suites 
-	"Nordmende" appliances
-	Generous storage areas
-	Integrated kitchens 
-	Utility room with storage 
-	Underground parking available 
-	Secure bicycle storage
-	Excellent energy rating A2-A3
-	Pet friendly apartments 
-	Resident's App 

Residents will benefit from an unmatched range of exclusive amenities, with an on-site management suite and concierge service.  The amenities space includes:

-	Management Team 
-	Concierge Service
-	Co-Working Suite
-	Meeting Rooms
-	Focus Booths 
-	Landscaped Rooftop Terraces 
-	Community Lounge 
-	Residents' Kitchen
-	Game Zone
-	Childrens Play Den
-	Console Room
-	Childrens Playground
-	MyPup (complimentary Parcel Collection Service) 
-	1 Acre of Community Green Space and Courtyards
-	Residents' private gym
-	Pet Wash Station
-	Regular community events for residents

Located in Dublin's central location of the North Docks, The Residence Coopers Cross is ideally situated for anyone looking to live in Dublin's City Centre. Key employment hubs are located on the North and South of the docks with Dublin City now seen as one of Ireland's leading tech locations. The North Docks is also home to an array of eateries, music venues, historic tales, and a flourishing community culture. 

It is also perfectly positioned beside numerous transport options that include: 

-	Luas Red Line - 1 Min Walk 
-	Docklands Rail Station - 5 Min Walk
-	Dublin Bikes - 1 Min Walk
-	Dublin Bus - 2 Min Walk
-	Dublin Airport - 15 Min Drive  

For more information on what The Residence Coopers Cross can offer you, contact us today and arrange a viewing.
